facts.business: Bosch Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of automotive products (including power solutions, safety & braking systems) and non-automotive products (power tools, building technologies/fire safety) in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure (excluding capital advance, capital creditors and ROU)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Indian automotive market outlook for 2026-27 remains in the growth trajectory with expectation of high single-digit growth
Indian power tools market expected to grow at CAGR of around ~7% over next 3 years
Acquisition of RBIC expected to be completed by end of Q1 2026-27

key_risks: Escalating geopolitical tensions could drive cost pressures and disruptions across automotive value chain
Intensified competition from Chinese/new entrants in lower to mid-price segments
Prolonged Middle East conflict could act as dampener for power tools outlook
Highly competitive and price-sensitive fire safety market with fragmented landscape
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances in nature of loans to subsidiaries: Robert Bosch India Manufacturing and Technology Private Limited - Rs 34.5 million; to firms/companies where directors are interested: Bosch Automotive Electronics India Private Limited - Rs 4,500 million
